H1_Role: Predictive mixed-effects candidate; regional climate response terms are included in every candidate fixed-effects formula, but CV selection makes it unsuitable as confirmatory full-period inference
H1_Temperature_Coverage: Region-specific December-temperature effects are included in all optimized nlme candidate formulas
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Region-specific linear sm_z response in the baseline formula, or region-specific sm_deficit and sm_wet branches in threshold formulas; selected formula is reported in selected_model_formula.txt
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Temperature and soil-moisture regional differences are represented in all candidate fixed-effects formulas; the selected specification is in selected_model_formula.txt
Specification_Warnings: Optimized forecasting model selected by rolling-origin validation within 2000-2012 and evaluated on 2013-2018. All candidate fixed formulas include a linear year_c trend. Response transformation and random-effect structure are also selected by validation. Do not use this selected forecasting model as the sole confirmatory H1 inference model.

H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Piecewise deficit/wet response common across regions
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Temperature regional difference estimable; soil-moisture regional difference not estimable
Specification_Warnings: No explicit harvest_year trend or year effect. No region:sm_deficit or region:sm_wet interaction, so regional soil-moisture sensitivity cannot be tested. Soil moisture is standardized within governorate.

H1_Temperature_Coverage: Common nonlinear temperature smooth; no region-specific temperature smooth
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Common nonlinear smooth; no region-specific soil-moisture smooth
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Primary temperature and soil-moisture regional differences not estimable; NDVI and VHI have region-specific smooths
Specification_Warnings: No explicit harvest_year trend or year effect. Temperature and soil-moisture smooths are shared across regions, so spatial H1 heterogeneity for these stressors is not tested. Soil moisture is standardized within governorate.

H1_Role: Predictive machine-learning comparator; not a coefficient-based H1 test model
H1_Temperature_Coverage: Potential nonlinear effects/interactions; no explicit regional slope contrast
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Potential nonlinear response; no explicit drought-branch parameterization
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Can explore regional patterns using model-based explanations; no direct coefficient test
Specification_Warnings: No explicit harvest_year predictor. Variable importance is not a signed causal effect or a conventional coefficient hypothesis test.

H1_Role: Pooled predictive baseline; deliberately excludes spatial heterogeneity
H1_Soil_Moisture_Coverage: Common linear raw soil-moisture slope only
Regional_Heterogeneity_Coverage: Not estimable: model is intentionally pooled
Specification_Warnings: No governorate or region effect by deliberate baseline design; it cannot validate spatial heterogeneity. No explicit harvest_year effect.
